{#-
  Swap Tag  ── 2" × 4" @ 300 DPI  (600 × 1200 dots)  portrait
  ZD420 printer
  ---------------------------------------------------------------
  Zone layout (top to bottom):
    y =   25 —  120   : Brand      (label + underline + value)
    y =  140 —  235   : Model
    y =  255 —  350   : Size
    y =  370 —  465   : Color
    y =  490 —  685   : Swap Price (big)
    y =  700 —  740   : MSRP (strikethrough)
    y =  770 —  773   : dashed separator
    y =  810 —  985   : Code 128 barcode (with digits below)
    y = 1010 — 1040   : item_code text
  Fields pulled:
    doc.brand              → Brand value
    doc.custom_model       → Model value
    doc.custom_size        → Size value
    doc.custom_color       → Color value
    doc.custom_swap_price  → big featured price
    doc.standard_rate      → MSRP crossed out
    doc.custom_upc_helper / doc.item_code → barcode
-#}
^XA
^PW600
^LL1200
^CI28
^FO0,25^A0N,26,26^FB600,1,0,C,0^FDBrand^FS
^FO200,55^GB200,0,2^FS
^FO0,75^A0N,48,48^FB600,1,0,C,0^FD{{ (doc.brand or "")[:20] }}^FS
^FO0,140^A0N,26,26^FB600,1,0,C,0^FDModel^FS
^FO200,170^GB200,0,2^FS
^FO0,190^A0N,48,48^FB600,1,0,C,0^FD{{ (doc.custom_model or "")[:20] }}^FS
^FO0,255^A0N,26,26^FB600,1,0,C,0^FDSize^FS
^FO240,285^GB120,0,2^FS
^FO0,305^A0N,48,48^FB600,1,0,C,0^FD{{ (doc.custom_size or "")[:20] }}^FS
^FO0,370^A0N,26,26^FB600,1,0,C,0^FDColor^FS
^FO230,400^GB140,0,2^FS
^FO0,420^A0N,48,48^FB600,1,0,C,0^FD{{ (doc.custom_color or "")[:20] }}^FS
^FO0,490^A0N,28,28^FB600,1,0,C,0^FDPrice:^FS
^FO240,522^GB120,0,2^FS
^FO0,555^A0N,120,120^FB600,1,0,C,0^FD${{ "{:.2f}".format(doc.custom_swap_price or 0) }}^FS
^FO0,700^A0N,36,36^FB600,1,0,C,0^FDMSRP: ${{ "{:.2f}".format(doc.standard_rate or 0) }}^FS
^FO150,720^GB300,0,3^FS
^FO40,770^GB520,0,3,B,3^FS
{%- set barcode_data = doc.custom_upc_helper or doc.item_code -%}
{% if barcode_data %}
^BY3,2,150
^FO150,810^BCN,150,Y,N,N,A^FD{{ barcode_data }}^FS
{% endif %}
^FO0,1010^A0N,28,28^FB600,1,0,C,0^FD{{ doc.item_code or "" }}^FS
^XZ
